name: Hayes with NEO & CRAVO
description: Dive into Porto's legendary underground scene with a night of powerful techno at the iconic Gare club.
longDescription:
On October 16, 2026, Gare Porto hosts a night of techno featuring Hayes alongside local artists NEO and CRAVO. Hayes is known for their contributions to the contemporary techno landscape, often exploring driving rhythms and intricate soundscapes. This event brings together international and Portuguese talent within the electronic music genre, offering a focused evening of powerful, percussive sounds.

Attendees can expect an immersive club experience characteristic of Gare Porto, a venue celebrated for its industrial aesthetic and robust sound system. The atmosphere will be geared towards serious electronic music enthusiasts, with the event running late into the night. The focus will be on the music and the collective energy on the dance floor, typical of a dedicated techno event.

Tickets are required for entry. Gare Porto is located near the city center and is accessible via public transport. The venue is a short walk from the São Bento metro station, served by multiple lines.
